review_method: Primary agent visually inspected plan +6.070, high-resolution plan +9.110 and full section; adjacent and typical plans were inspected during preparation. Distinguish directly visible endpoints from inferred correspondence. Model agreement is not independent ground truth.
direct_observations: On plan +6.070 the upper-left leader is OGM3, upper-right OGM4, lower OGM2.
On plan +9.110 the upper-left leader before the break is OGM6; lower and upper-right leaders are OGM5.
The section identifies OGM4 on +6.070 to +7.270 and OGM5 on +7.270 to +9.110. Plan and section reverse A3/A5 horizontal orientation.

inference.basis: Same position before the break as OGM3 for the previous flight on plan +6.070, consistent with the previous-flight mapping on the typical plan.
inference.why_not_preferred: Would change the preceding/next-flight correspondence to match a familiar mark; typical top level makes that assignment inconsistent.
inference.confidence_limit: Right-side upper OGM5 leaders remain unresolved. The mapping is reconstructed, not an explicit elevation range printed beside the leader.

original_claim_parts.standalone_landing_guardrail: refuted as phrased; leaders refer to flight railing
original_claim_parts.cross_view_mark_difference: supported in bounded wording by cross-plan inference

bounded_wording: На листе 5 выявлено расхождение обозначений ограждения марша +6.070 → +7.270: на разрезе 1-1 и на схеме +6.070 указано ОГМ 4, тогда как на схеме +9.110 соответствующий левый фрагмент до разрыва обозначен ОГМ 6. Соответствие установлено по осям, последовательности отметок и условности соседних планов; речь идёт об ограждении марша, а не о доказанном самостоятельном ограждении площадки +7.270. Следует уточнить принадлежность выноски и согласовать марку с границами изделия и деталями листа 6. ОГМ 4 и ОГМ 6 конструктивно различаются, поэтому неоднозначность может привести к выбору другого изделия. Правая верхняя выноска ОГМ 5 на схеме +9.110 и типовом плане остаётся отдельно неразрешённой.
disposition: Retain/reopen the coordination finding with corrected flight terminology. Do not use F-014 as a proven false-positive filter control. No automatic production release.
frozen_evaluator_v2: unchanged; case remains excluded pending a separately versioned adjudication
quality_claim: Known-candidate source investigation, not recovered blind finding and not full comparative acceptance.
new_method_candidate: For ambiguous multi-view identity, compare adjacent plans and drafting break conventions before suppression; split wrong object wording from the factual discrepancy.
remaining: Right-upper OGM5 correspondence and final design correction require separate review; do not multiply inferred defects.
